description: This file implements a server for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the Playwright project, including server creation, request handling, heartbeat management, and client connection setup.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a server backend using a specified transport and optional heartbeat.

methods.name: wrapInProcess
methods.description: Wraps a backend server in an in-process transport.

methods.name: wrapInClient
methods.description: Creates a client connected to an in-process server backend.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates and configures an MCP server with request handlers for listing tools and calling tools.

methods.name: initializeServer
methods.description: Initializes server capabilities and starts heartbeat if enabled.

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic pinging of the server to maintain connection health.

methods.name: addServerListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners for server events such as 'close' or 'initialized'.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, either via in-process transport or HTTP, and logs configuration details.

methods.name: firstRootPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the first root in client info.

methods.name: allRootPaths
methods.description: Returns all file system paths from the roots in client info.

methods.name: mergeTextParts
methods.description: Merges consecutive text parts in a CallToolResult into a single text block.
